dct_description_sm:
Notes on Preservation Files:

For preservation purposes, 'flat file' versions of the multi-spreadsheet Excel workbooks contained in this dataset have been created. The content of these Excel workbooks have been exported into preservation-friendly format and stored in the Preservation Files zip archive.

As part of the "Management of Stemphylium leaf blight" thesis research, EC50 values, inhibition (%) and categorical assignment conidial and mycelial response of isolates of S. vesicarium to FRAC group 7 (succinate dehydrogenase inhibitor) fungicides, fluxapyroxad and penflufen, after exposure in vitro.
dct_title_s: Management of Stemphylium leaf blight: S. vesicarium resistance to fluxapyroxad and penflufen active ingredients
